newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - April 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - April 4.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Friday's Daily Variety:
* Former CBS-Broadcast Group president Howard Stringer is in serious talks to join Sony Corp of America in a senior position, sources said.
* The U.S. Federal Communications Commission voted to give every television station in the country a second channel so that they could each begin broadcasting a high-tech signal.
* Robin Williams and Billy Crystal, who star in the upcoming Time Warner Warner Bros movie "Fathers' Day," will make guest appearances on the Warner Bros television series "Friends".
* The Directors Guild Of America has appointed a new committee to examine safety issues related to long hours in the entertainment industry.
* Sean Connery is in final negotiations to star as the arch-nemesis in Warner Bros' The Avengers for producer Jerry Weintraub and director Jeremiah Chechik, sources said.
* Miramax executive vice president of business and legal affairs John Logigian is set to join Jean Doumanian Prods, which produces the films of Woody Allen and other directors.
